description: This file defines the LogRecordIterator class within the Aws\CloudTrail namespace. It provides an iterator to parse and yield AWS CloudTrail log records from log files stored in S3 buckets. The class supports different initialization methods for specific trails, buckets, or individual files and handles reading and iterating over log records, managing internal state and file loading.

classes.name: LogRecordIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that reads CloudTrail log files from S3, loading and yielding individual log records as associative arrays, supporting iteration and nested file loading.

methods.name: forTrail
methods.description: Creates a LogRecordIterator for a specific CloudTrail trail, initializing from S3 bucket and client, possibly with filter options.

methods.name: forBucket
methods.description: Creates a LogRecordIterator for all logs within a specified S3 bucket, with optional filtering.

methods.name: forFile
methods.description: Creates a LogRecordIterator for a specific log file in S3, given its bucket and object key.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with a LogFileReader and an iterator over log file locations.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current log record as an array.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next log record, loading new files if needed.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current record's key, combining file key and index.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current record position is valid.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the beginning of the log files.

methods.name: getInnerIterator
methods.description: Returns the inner log file iterator.

methods.name: loadRecordsFromCurrentLogFile
methods.description: Loads log records from the current file in the iterator, returning true if successful.
